description: A 3 kg lid on a box with one gas strut. Lift the lid by its front edge: below about 68 degrees its weight wins and it falls shut; above that the strut wins and lifts it to the 95 degree stop. Change the strut force in Settings and try again.
notes: Starter example for the mechanism playground. Parts are made by make_parts.py; the lid's mass, centre of mass and inertia come from its mesh (build/pack.py). The physics is in mechanism.js: one DOF (lid angle), weight torque from the mass table, gas strut torque from its length change, hinge friction.
